task.instruction: For this call, write only the opening approximately two minutes of the supplied episode, aiming for 220–270 spoken Russian words, then stop. The full-episode duration and plan remain context for the larger work, not the requested output length. Cover the inspection and the transition to asking people questions. Choose the opening words yourself. Return the complete requested excerpt in the ordinary WriteOutput utterances structure, with the supplied speaker labels and output_language.

change: Only opening_task is added to the full original user payload; author instructions and story are unchanged.
assessment: One sample per author; no repair, editorial feedback, reranking or length-driven regeneration.
word_count: Unicode word groups including numbers, with internal hyphens/apostrophes counted as one word.
